teaser: A Raspberry Pi setup guide in five manual stages, turned round: the Factory images once, the owner plugs in two cables, and every unit is the same.
core_idea: Setting up a Raspberry Pi with a website and a local model takes five manual stages full of choices where an owner gives up, so the Factory should do them once as a tested image with a small per-unit part and a printer-style Wi-Fi setup, leaving the owner two cables and a page, which is what lets the appliance scale and what the Kickstarter can promise.
